note: Public facilities only. Opening as a cooling or warming center is seasonal and announced by the city; nothing here says a place is open now, has backup power or is accessible unless the cited source says so. Coordinates are not stored: the app looks up each public address with Apple Maps. A place's own retrievedAt, when present, overrides the file date. Warming-center roles are event-specific: a library listed here was announced as a warming center for a past storm and must be confirmed with the city before the next one.
